## 3. Executive Summary
UNICO Built Environments is an award-winning national construction leader specializing in high-rise structural engineering, sub-millimeter trade coordination, 3D Building Information Modeling (BIM), and 7D BIM cloud digital twin handovers. Over four decades, UNICO has delivered over 380 million square feet of landmark commercial towers, mission-critical institutional facilities, and luxury residential developments across 450+ completed projects while maintaining a verified 0.00% structural settlement rate and a zero-incident safety record.

---

## 4. Organization Overview
UNICO operates under a single-source project accountability model, uniting pre-construction 3D utility mapping, self-performing master trade craftsmanship, third-party ISO 17025 accredited laboratory testing, and 24/7 live site camera transparency. The firm employs over 1,200 master trade artisans, structural engineers, BIM managers, and project superintendents across North America.

## 7. Mission & Engineering Philosophy
1. **Integrity in Every Layer**: Concealed structural caissons and MEP conduits are inspected to the same standard as polished facade marble.
2. **Precision Over Shortcuts**: Robotic GPS total stations deliver sub-millimeter 0.5mm survey accuracy.
3. **Safety as Non-Negotiable**: Enforcing zero compromise on site worker health and daily physical protection.
4. **Named Accountability**: Every project features a named Lead Engineer who owns single-source responsibility.
5. **Craft Discipline**: High-performance concrete metallurgy (10,000+ PSI) and Italian stone cladding executed with master union trade discipline.
6. **Environmental Control**: Sustainable site practices reducing urban construction dust and carbon footprint by 32.4%.

---

## 8. Services & Building Programs
- **High-Rise Structural Engineering**: Cast-in-place post-tensioned concrete, climbing core formwork, and structural steel framing up to 60+ stories.
- **3D BIM Spatial Coordination**: Pre-fabrication clash detection eliminating 99.4% of field mechanical conflicts.
- **7D BIM Digital Twin Handover**: Cloud-native 3D asset models connecting structural, electrical, and plumbing data directly to facility management software.
- **Facade & Building Envelope**: Unitized curtain wall installation, dynamic terracotta rainscreens, and triple-glazed structural glass (180 MPH wind rating).
- **Pre-Construction Feasibility**: 3D underground utility sweeps, soil mechanics analysis, and true-cost constructability modeling.

## 13. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Q: What distinguishes UNICO from standard general contractors?**
  A: UNICO integrates pre-construction 3D utility mapping, self-performing master trade craftsmanship, ISO 17025 accredited materials testing, and full 7D BIM digital twin handovers under single-source accountability.
- **Q: What is a 7D BIM Digital Twin Handover?**
  A: A cloud-accessible 3D model embedded with component specs, maintenance schedules, warranty documents, and operational data for structural, electrical, and plumbing assets.
- **Q: How does UNICO manage cost and schedule risk?**
  A: Through open-book financial estimating, BIM clash detection before fabrication, 3D underground utility sweeps, and 24/7 live site camera access for clients.

## 17. Technical Overview
- **Frontend Architecture**: High-performance semantic HTML5, Vanilla CSS design system, CSS Custom Properties, and modular ES6 JavaScript.
- **Interactive Canvas Engine**: Custom HTML5 Canvas scrubber rendering 1,800 sequence frames (900 preloaded PNG frames in `aug-4/` duplicated 2x for prolonged scroll experience) driven by scroll position.
- **Sticky Scroll Architecture**: GPU-accelerated subpixel translation engine (`translate3d`) with lerp inertia smoothing.
